purpose: Pre-publication implementation and local verification record; not a production attestation
features: Shareable library query, kind and saved-only filters, including Back and reload
Preserve an unflushed query before opening a record; handle IME and stale asynchronous navigation
Tab-session return from a record to the original search or library card with focus and scroll restoration
Keyboard-accessible full-page search results without changing quick-search combobox navigation
Current-section menu visibility and keyboard focus restoration without moving the underlying page
Unambiguous source download explanation and non-duplicated 404 recovery links
Settle WebKit's observed post-bookmark fragment adjustment at the same offset, once after an own bookmark DOM commit
Retain the return journey while its own opening is in flight; isolate cancellation, completion and timers by context identity

coordination.method: Normal merges preserving the four other chats' changes; dirty owner checkout not edited

preserved: Owner prose, names, source data and intentional duplicate entries
Rider long-press selection and vertical page scrolling
Removal of Ultra runtime settings, while retaining story form names
No public gallery upload or title edit during verification

repositoryGates.productionBuild: passed without running local database migrations

startupFileBudget.measurement: Decoded files and reproducible gzip size, not elapsed startup or network transfer time

browserVerification.webkit: passed; the same five viewports and full touch/mouse, keyboard and return journeys
webkitFixBoundaries: Only own bookmark commits on hash-bearing library pages; cold hydration and unrelated renders do not scroll
Same x/y coordinates, no history, focus, pointer-default or pointer-capture change
Shared rail, load-gate, press feedback and root scroll CSS remain unchanged
Press/margin/default-blocking hypotheses were rejected by independent contrasts; speculative changes were removed
browserVerification.menuHarness: The already-visible sticky opener is hit-tested and clicked at its measured center. WebKit locator auto-scroll independently moved it 83px before pointerdown; coordinate input preserved the page through opening, closing, focus restoration and unlock. No app workaround was added for this harness behavior.
browserVerification.searchHarness: Search waits for its existing world-page-visible hydration lifecycle before exercising client-side handlers. Its SSR links already have valid native hrefs; the family and font signals alone do not establish that draft capture is hydrated.
coverage: Library query then immediate record open; native Back, reload, explicit return and stable card focus
Saved-only shelf, removal focus, reload and touch/mouse filter activation
Search Tab navigation, record round trip and original result focus
Quoted and handwritten numeric library URL round trips
No horizontal overflow; download/404 recovery and current-location menu row
Clock-boundary library/search arrival after more than 15 seconds of Date time; actual elapsed browser time is recorded separately
A real route-preparation deadline clears the pending journey without a late navigation
pendingJourneyBoundaries: Only the exact in-memory capture receives an in-flight lease; no lease is stored across reloads
Persisted abandoned leaving state still expires after 15 seconds; all states retain the 30-minute maximum
Back, pagehide, explicit cancellation, changed source/target and failed or ignored openings cannot revive an old capture
Same-millisecond captures, queued old timers and late promise completion are isolated by object identity
Shared load gate, Rexonance warmup and destination-arrival highlight timeout are unchanged
browserVerification.adversarialEvidence: output/playwright/record-return-durable-adversarial-summary.json; five isolated Chromium cases passed with no page errors. Raw reports distinguish a corrected diagnostic-only record-selection error from application behavior.
browserVerification.physicalDevices: Not tested; iPhone/iPad Safari and installed-PWA checks remain with the owner

previousPublicVerification.status: Exact identity and public smoke passed; independent full Chromium and WebKit five-viewport reruns passed
initialObservations: The first Chromium run reached Zeus without a return link; cause was not established. The search hydration wait and the independently proven 15-second in-flight boundary are treated separately.

The first WebKit run reported two Rex atlas access-control messages. Both assets returned 200/basic in independent fetches, the full rerun passed without page errors, and an explicit abort/retry contrast passed. The original message did not reproduce; no application workaround or error allowlist was added.

publication.method: Normal push to main, deploy-main.yml gates and exact-release public verification
publication.attestation: Publication is verified separately after CI; this source file does not claim that publication has completed
